note: Lunenburg County has a zoning ordinance (Municode) but publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county's GIS (lunenburg.southsidegis.org, the county's ArcGIS Online MapInsights service) has no zoning layer; its Tax Parcels layer has a Zoning field but it is blank for all parcels. The 2019-2024 joint comprehensive plan has only a generalized zoning map (PDF) and the county planned an official zoning map but none is published as GIS. Towns of Kenbridge and Victoria publish no zoning GIS either; Victoria refers building permits to the county. ArcGIS Online searches for Lunenburg zoning found only parcel, address and survey layers.
